description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1528/10 of 17.12.2007, Homagama D/S Divison and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, land extents, and title classifications for various land parcels in different locations. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
